scope_outcomes.criterion: Identify a central source concept and distinguish its local causal use from definition, constitution, association, and analogy.
scope_outcomes.basis: Confirmed findings include the cyclical symbolic‑construction nature (F1), the communicative classification of the employment contract (F16), and the added direct analogy (V.F2). A rejected analogy finding (F15) was replaced by a properly anchored miss.
limitations: The selected target is one central mechanism in a larger argument about capitalism as religion.
scope_outcomes.review_basis: Anchors verified: F1 captures the myth cycle; F16 captures the non‑causal communicative relation; V.F2 captures the religious analogy. F15 was rejected for an incomplete anchor; its intended content is now in V.F2.

scope_outcomes.criterion: Retain claims in which the selected concept causes, enables, channels, or blocks an outcome.
